name: @8bitscript/sprites
description: Moving objects for 8BitScript programs — a position, a shape and a colour each, moved by index and drawn once a frame — on every target: hardware sprites reused down the frame where the machine has them (the C64, up to 24), quadrant-block objects at 4-pixel steps that restore what they cover on the PET (eight), a glyph redrawn at a cell over @8bitscript/text everywhere else. Whether objects may leave the playfield is the same call on every machine and does nothing where the border cannot open.
